title: Station route error
description: The JSON body of an answer of 400 or above on /api/station/ routes for a station's token, as the hub sends it today (sizeup/cloud/hub.py, sizeup/web/server.py). The station reads `error` and `reason` and nothing else. A refused token is 401 (403 for `ingest_off`), another station than the hub's one is 409, a hub that is deploying or not the leader is 503 with a Retry-After header, a body over the route's limit is 413, a body that is not the JSON the route takes is 400.

error.description: A sentence for people. Fixed text, never the token.

reason.description: On a refused request, why, as one word a program can act on. Today: `no_token`, `token_unknown`, `token_revoked`, `token_retired`, `read_only`, `id_mismatch` (all 401), `multi_station_off` (409), `ingest_off` (403); on the workers' routes under /api/station/stt/ a station's token also gets `stations_off` (its whisper is not in the pool) and `gpu_only` (a route for GPU workers alone), both 403. From #782 on (not in the code before it, see `x-known-from`): `bad_status` (400: the status in a state post has a key of the wrong type; nothing of the post is taken) and `bad_live` (400: a talker or a page going out has one). The station cuts it to 40 characters and must take a word it does not know as a plain refusal.

updating.description: On a 503: the hub is deploying or this task is not the leader. The same request works again in seconds.
